Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL1824 (Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2). Join molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL1824, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, organism Homo sapiens, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, non-null canonical_smiles, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi present. Return DISTINCT rows for compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not add sorting.
